paragraphs: I'm Shaibal, a Computer Engineering graduate from the University of Toronto with 16 months of software engineering internship experience. I focus on backend and full-stack systems, with experience in authentication, developer tooling, data pipelines, and performance-sensitive software.

I like problems that cross layers. I trace how APIs, storage, and interfaces affect one another, then test my decisions through profiling, failure testing, and benchmarks. I'm looking for an early-career role where I can take ownership and learn from experienced engineers.
Outside of work, I run, play soccer, read fantasy novels, and experiment with game development.
